title: 第160章 冰晶阵照见自我凰青归梦收巾谨第159章 百万年相守她只为夺走我的吻
content_zh:
;;
巾谨只当这是一吻诀别。
我心里却已经拿定主意，要带她走。
要么与她“血脉融合”，收入“阴阳空间”；
要么吸收她的“本命阳玉”，纳入“灵玉空间”。
所剩时间不多，我反倒犹豫着该怎么开口。
此情此景提双修，实在太过唐突。
“哥哥，你走神啦。”她指尖轻轻蹭了蹭我的手背。
“我想看星星。”
“那……行吧。我得先准备一下。”
她抬手一挥，召出“至阳化身”“至阳护卫”，还有一顶50米见方的大帐篷。
化身和护卫都是她本来的模样。
见我脸上没有半分惊讶，她悄悄松了口气——知道我已经猜到她不是真的“珍恋”。
化身与护卫拎着她的随身背包，低头钻进了帐篷。
她这是要准备什么？
“哥哥，以后我的‘至阳护卫’和‘至阳化身’，会一直陪着你。”
“可惜我的棺材不够大。”我一本正经地叹了口气。
“那……可以把我的护卫和化身，收进我们的‘阴阳空间’里。”
话说完，她立刻低下头，耳根子都红透了。
开启“阴阳空间”必须以阴阳交融为引，她这话已经是明明白白的暗示。

看来她也不想再耗着心思猜来猜去。
莫非她先前说的“敞开心扉看星星”，是暗指她要做我心里最亮的那颗星？
搭这顶帐篷，就是要和我一同敞开心扉，开启属于我们的“阴阳空间”？
这帐篷着实大了些。
何况峡谷里的雾气钻得进帐篷，里头能见度也就1米，再大的空间也派不上用场。
我也不能再装糊涂，伸手将她揽进怀里，稍一用力便拦腰抱起，迈步朝帐篷走去。
“哥哥，还没准备好呢。”
我脚步一顿，愣了愣。
原来她真的要给我看星星。
心里竟生出几分期待。
……
片刻后，帐帘掀开，她的护卫和化身走了出来。
她抬眼冲我眨了眨眼，随即又埋回我怀里。
看样子，帐篷里头已经布置妥当了。
我掀开帐帘。
哟，里头照旧弥漫着雾气，光线偏暗，能见度还不到1米。
我刚踏进去，护卫和化身便从身后封死了帐帘。
“哥哥，你闭上眼睛，把身体控制权交给‘智脑’，再把你的‘智脑’共享给我。”
content_en:
;;
Jin Jin just thought it was a kiss to say goodbye.
But I had already made up my mind to take her away.
Either "bloodline fusion" with her and income into the "yin and yang space";
Either absorb her "natal Yang Jade" and incorporate it into the "Spiritual Jade Space".
There wasn't much time left, so I was hesitant about what to say.
It is too abrupt to mention dual cultivation in this situation and situation.
"Brother, you are distracted." Her fingertips gently rubbed the back of my hand.
"I want to see the stars."
"Then...okay. I have to prepare first."
She raised her hand and summoned the "Incarnation of the Ultimate Sun" and "Guardian of the Ultimate Sun", as well as a large tent measuring 50 meters square.
Both the avatar and the guardian are her original appearance.
Seeing that there was no trace of surprise on my face, she quietly breathed a sigh of relief - knowing that I had guessed that she was not really "Zhen Lian".
The avatar and the guard carried her backpack and ducked into the tent.
What is she preparing for?
"Brother, my 'Zhiyang Guard' and 'Zhiyang Incarnation' will always be with you from now on."
"Too bad my coffin isn't big enough." I sighed seriously.
"Then... you can take my guards and incarnations into our 'yin and yang space'."
After saying that, she immediately lowered her head, her ears turning red.
Opening the "yin and yang space" must be guided by the blending of yin and yang. Her words are a clear hint.
It seemed that she didn't want to spend any more time guessing.
Could it be that when she said "open your heart and look at the stars" earlier, she was implying that she wanted to be the brightest star in my heart?
By setting up this tent, you want to open your heart with me and open up our "yin and yang space"?
This tent is really big.
What's more, the fog in the canyon can penetrate into the tent, and the visibility inside is only 1 meter, so no matter how large the space is, it will be useless.
I couldn't pretend to be confused anymore, so I reached out and took her into my arms. With a little effort, I picked her up by the waist and walked towards the tent.
"Brother, I'm not ready yet."
I stopped walking and was stunned.
It turns out she really wants to show me the stars.
There was some expectation in my heart.
…
After a moment, the curtain opened and her escort and avatar came out.
She raised her eyes and blinked at me, then buried herself back in my arms.
It seems that the tent has been properly arranged.
I opened the curtain.
Oh, it's still filled with fog, the light is dim, and the visibility is less than 1 meter.
As soon as I stepped in, the guards and avatars sealed the tent from behind.
"Brother, close your eyes, give control of your body to your 'intelligent brain', and then share your 'intelligent brain' with me."
